mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of economic conditions.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for FEDFUNDS as a predictor of 20-day S&P 500 returns is less than 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window, or 20-day returns when FEDFUNDS declines are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation exceeds 3.0%, it triggers expectations of aggressive monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 3.0%, or the Rank IC for CPIAUCSL as a predictor of negative returns is less than -0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in retail sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate broad consumer demand contraction that reduces corporate revenue visibility, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in RSAFS and HOUST fails to predict negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is less than -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 6.0%), a decline in payroll employment (PAYEMS) signals deteriorating labor market conditions that suppress consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where UNRATE > 6.0%, PAYEMS decline does not produce negative 20-day returns in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC for PAYEMS decline in this regime is less than -0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate exceeds 5.0%, it indicates labor market weakness that reduces consumer spending velocity, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE > 5.0%, or the Rank IC for UNRATE as a predictor of negative 5-day returns is less than -0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals manufacturing sector contraction that reduces corporate output capacity and profit margins, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days regardless of economic conditions.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for INDPRO as a predictor of 60-day S&P 500 returns is less than -0.03 over any 1-year rolling window, or 60-day returns when INDPRO declines are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 450.0 thousand units, it signals housing market contraction that reduces household wealth and consumer spending, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where HOUST < 450.0, or the Rank IC for HOUST as a predictor of negative 5-day returns is less than -0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In low inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL < 2.0%), an increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals premature monetary tightening that disrupts economic growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where CPIAUCSL < 2.0%, FEDFUNDS increase does not produce negative 60-day returns in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC for FEDFUNDS rise in this regime is less than -0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
